"Slide" is a song by American alternative rock group Goo Goo Dolls.
It was released as the first single from their sixth studio album, Dizzy Up the Girl, in September 1998.
According to lead guitarist John Rzeznik, the song is about a Catholic girl who becomes pregnant and discusses with her boyfriend how they should respond to it.
